ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Improving Your Research Skills. Prerequisite: Author or co-author of at least one research paper or approval from instructor. This class aims at improving graduate students' research skills including: 1) how to formulate high impact research problems; 2) how to create a research agenda and carry it out; and 3) how to give presentations and write papers. For an overview, see Elements of Research (http://www-rtsl.cs.uiuc.edu/misc/research.pdf). The study will be conducted in the context of research on building robust software systems.
